findings.name: Bowling Sur - Parquesur

findings.note: Parquesur Leganes bowling/FEC. Spain PIU community maps (piuspain / Arcade Rebirth / Nextage) do not list this venue. No positive proof of absence: unknown, not confirmed_none.

findings.name: Centro Comercial Pasarela Los Cristianos
findings.evidence_quote: Shopping centre with a few chinese versions of maimai (dance3) and dancerush (dance battle) rhythm games, arcade in 3rd floor. Music Game: 舞战纪 (Dance Battle) (China) Perfect; 舞立方 (DANCE³) (China) Perfect.
findings.note: Chinese maimai-like (DANCE³) and DanceRush-like (Dance Battle) clones, not official maimai_dx/drs. Mapped to other only. Reddit r/rhythmgames also reports Dance Battle found in Tenerife. 2024 ZIv visit; re-confirm status if visiting.

findings.note: Active retro barcade/museum Alcorcon. Public machine list is classic/pinball/fighters, no DDR/PIU/maimai found, but not a positive 'no rhythm games' statement: unknown. Seeking new premises (press 2026).

findings.note: Cangas MUVI. Documented playable set is classic SEGA racing/shooters, no rhythm. Incomplete public catalog so not confirmed_none.

findings.name: NEXT LEVEL Bar Madrid
findings.evidence_quote: Music Game: StepMania Converted Cabinet (International) Location: 2nd floor Comment: Euromix 2 cabinet converted to ITG. Using a PIU SX CRT. Almost 8000 songs including all DDR Packs, ITG, customs, etc. Free Play, Great. Official site: Rule the dance floor on the dance machine.
findings.note: Callao/Tudescos barcade (+18). StepMania/ITG convert is not commercial StepManiaX product, so slug other (not stepmaniax). Not a PIU Phoenix / official DDR cabinet. Do not confuse with Nextage Madrid or Next Level Maragall Barcelona (other PIU community spots).
